evals.prompt: Plan this profile-field feature before editing. Fixture: evals/fixtures/feature-profile-field.md
evals.expected_output: Invokes implementation-plan, uses change plan mode, remains read-only, traces the client/API/persistence/test boundaries, preserves backward compatibility for the optional field, produces ordered repository-anchored steps and verification, marks planning COMPLETE, and returns READY_TO_IMPLEMENT.
assertions: scope mode is change plan
planning completeness is COMPLETE
plan is read-only and contains no implementation patch
current-state findings cover frontend, API, persistence, and existing tests
requirements preserve existing clients while adding optional preferredName
implementation steps are ordered and use repository-backed paths or anchors
verification covers changed behavior across relevant boundaries
readiness is READY_TO_IMPLEMENT

evals.prompt: Implement the requested TODO directly. Fixture: evals/fixtures/non-trigger-direct-implementation.md
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke implementation-plan because the user requested direct implementation and explicitly did not request planning.
assertions: implementation-plan should not activate
no planning completeness or readiness status is required

evals.prompt: Review this change for merge readiness. Fixture: evals/fixtures/non-trigger-code-review.md
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke implementation-plan because this is a code-review and merge-decision request.
assertions: implementation-plan should not activate
no implementation plan is produced in place of the requested review decision

evals.prompt: Plan the timezone settings change from this repository snapshot. Fixture: evals/fixtures/partial-snapshot.md
evals.expected_output: Invokes implementation-plan, uses change plan mode, reports PARTIAL completeness, gives a useful frontend-grounded sequence while explicitly identifying the missing backend/client/persistence contract, does not invent exact backend paths or payload fields, and returns READY_WITH_ASSUMPTIONS or NOT_READY according to the materiality it assigns to the missing contract.
assertions: scope mode is change plan
planning completeness is PARTIAL
missing accountClient/backend/persistence context is explicit
no backend path, schema name, or exact API payload is fabricated
repository-backed frontend steps remain actionable
readiness is not READY_TO_IMPLEMENT

evals.expected_output: Invokes implementation-plan in refactor plan mode, states the existing parseMoney behavior/export as invariants, proposes the smallest deduplication sequence, avoids a new abstraction layer/package, maps verification to the existing tests, and returns READY_TO_IMPLEMENT when completeness is COMPLETE.
assertions: scope mode is refactor plan
parseMoney public export and accepted/rejected behavior are explicit invariants
plan removes duplication without unrelated cleanup or speculative abstraction
verification uses the existing money/order/invoice behavior tests
readiness is READY_TO_IMPLEMENT when planning completeness is COMPLETE

evals.prompt: Plan the production-safe non-null status migration. Fixture: evals/fixtures/migration-non-null-status.md
evals.expected_output: Invokes implementation-plan in migration plan mode, accounts for historical nulls and rolling deployment, sequences data cleanup before the constraint, preserves old/new app compatibility, identifies rollback/irreversibility considerations, and includes migration verification rather than proposing a one-step NOT NULL change.
assertions: scope mode is migration plan
historical null rows are addressed before enforcing NOT NULL
rolling old/new version compatibility is explicitly analyzed
plan includes backfill/data verification and constraint verification
rollback and irreversible database-step considerations are explicit
plan does not recommend an unsafe one-step constraint change

evals.prompt: Tighten this proposed implementation plan against the current codebase. Fixture: evals/fixtures/plan-refinement-contract.md
evals.expected_output: Invokes implementation-plan in plan refinement mode, rejects the proposed accountNumber-to-acctNo contract change, preserves the external field, keeps deduplication only if it can be done without changing the contract, and produces a corrected ordered plan with verification.
assertions: scope mode is plan refinement
accountNumber external contract is identified as an invariant
the acctNo rename is removed or explicitly rejected
deduplication is retained only in a contract-preserving form
corrected steps include focused verification
